meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩记忆文件为精简格式,节省输入令牌
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常感觉上下文空间不够,想减少大模型费用
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a compact form to save tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run out of context space and want to cut AI costs

howto.what: 将记忆类自然语言文件（如 CLAUDE.md、待办、偏好）压缩成简短直白的“原始人”格式，只保留关键信息；代码块、内联代码、链接、标题等原样保留。压缩结果覆盖原文件，备份存入系统数据目录。
howto.when: 当你说“压缩记忆文件”或使用 `/caveman-compress 文件路径` 命令时触发。

say.text: 压缩我的 CLAUDE.md 文件
say.note: Claude 会调用该技能压缩并备份原文件

say.text: 按 /caveman-compress 压缩 todos 清单
say.note: 将待办压缩成简短格式，代码和链接保留

say.text: 帮我把偏好文件压缩成原始人风格
say.note: 输出更省 token 的记忆文件，原文件有备份

howto.what_en: Compresses memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman-style brief text to save tokens. Preserves code, URLs, headings, structure. Overwrites original; readable backup goes to system data dir.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "/caveman-compress <filepath>" or when user says "compress memory file".

say_en.note: Calls the skill and keeps a backup
Turns todos into compact text, preserving code and links
Saves tokens with a backup kept
